title: Portfolio Website
description: A personal portfolio site built with React (Vite) featuring interactive project displays and direct recruiter contact.
details: Built a componentized architecture using React (Vite) with reusable UI components
Implemented interactive project cards and a modal viewer for detailed project views
Rendered work experience dynamically from JSON-driven content
Added a one-click resume download for recruiters
Implemented a secure contact flow using formsubmit.co, enabling direct inbound recruiter contact
Built fully responsive styling across desktop and mobile
Hosted on GitHub

title: Budget Tracker
description: A Django-based personal finance app for tracking income and expenses.
details: Built with Django 5.2, organized into modular apps for budget, income, and expenses
Modeled recurring and one-time income/expenses using the Django ORM
Built form-driven CRUD views for adding, editing, and deleting entries
Used SQLite for local development and persistence
Prepared production deployment artifacts, including Gunicorn + systemd service units
Configured nginx site templates for production deployment
Set up STATIC_ROOT for collecting static assets via Django's collectstatic

title: Stock Prediction
description: A Python tool that uses a recurrent neural network to forecast stock prices.
details: Built a stacked-LSTM recurrent neural network (2 layers, 100 units each) using Keras/TensorFlow
Downloaded historical equity price data using yfinance
Engineered features including moving averages and percent returns
Normalized 60-day rolling input sequences using scikit-learn's MinMaxScaler
Trained with the Adam optimizer and mean-squared-error loss, using early stopping to reduce overfitting
Implemented iterative 7-day forecasting by feeding predictions back into the input sequence
Visualized predicted vs. actual closing prices with matplotlib

title: Resonode
description: An interactive music application that generates beats from on-screen clicks, built in Python.
details: Built in Python with a real-time interactive interface
Generates beats based on the screen location of user clicks
Supports looping at a user-selected time interval
Includes multiple sound presets that can be mixed and matched
Displays visual effects synced to the beat as it loops

title: Peer Service Marketplace
description: A full-stack peer-to-peer marketplace for booking local gig services.
details: Built as a team project with a React (Vite) frontend and a Django REST Framework backend
Enabled users to list, book, and pay for local services (tutoring, handyman, tech help, etc.)
Implemented in-app messaging between users
Added a review and ratings system for completed services
Modularized the backend into REST API apps: bookings, messaging, payments, reviews, services, and users
Used SQLite for local development
Prepared an nginx configuration for production deployment
Documented payment integration planning and architecture
